## What
Plan 015 step 3 (PR 015b): the `vanilla_path_*` GameTest flakes.

- `vanilla_path_wall_detour_beyond_the_short_search_still_arrives`: flowing water from a cave or aquifer cell beside or over the arena pocket poured into the air `SkirmishGameTests.openGround` had just cleared (it only stones a FallingBlock at y 5). The vanilla pathfinder ends its path at the water's edge. Fix: `ArenaReady.sealed(helper, outside)` stones the whole lid (y 5 over x/z 0..15), every rim cell beside the pocket (x/z -1 and 16, y 2..4) that is not a full block, and any fluid at y 1 or 5 round it; a fluid inside the pocket becomes air. It returns the fluid count and records the blocks it changed outside the arena, which the test puts back.
- `vanilla_path_melee_chaser_runs_down_a_walking_target`: not water. The chaser (a Zombie Villager) had `effect.minecraft.slowness 1`: the daylight Slowness II that undead units get (`Unit` sunlight effect, `ZombieVillagerUnit.getSunlightEffect`). That puts it at 0.175 against a runner at 0.15 (60% of its base speed), so the test's result depended on the time of day its batch ran. Fix: `ArenaReady.noSunlight(owners...)` gives the test's owners the sandbox cheat `slipslopslap` (monster units unaffected by sunlight) and returns an undo. `around()` showed clear air and no neighbours, so the pad (plan 3c) is not needed.
- All three `vanilla_path_*` tests call `sealed` after `openGround` and append `fluid cells removed: n` to their failure text. The chaser and the shooter also use `noSunlight`. For the shooter it is not the same exposure: `SkeletonUnit` (:281-286) gives Slowness II only to a Skeleton wearing a helmet, and the test's helmetless Skeleton gets FIRE (it burns) instead, so `noSunlight` only stops it burning. `sealed` also stones the non-full rim cells in the chaser and shooter tests (`ArenaReady.java:86`), which goes beyond plan 3a's fluid scan: it removes a variable of the generated layout, not an assertion. No assertion changed.
- Known wording error, not fixed on this head: the `noSunlight` javadoc (`ArenaReady.java:98`) says the opposite about the Skeleton. Fixing it would move the head after the Mode A review, so it stays as a follow-up unless another change is needed.
- New test, written first: `sealed_arena_has_no_fluid_after_openGround` places water over the pocket's middle (8,5,8) and on the rim (-1,3,8), calls openGround + sealed, then after 20 ticks asserts there is no fluid in the y 2..4 pocket and that both fluid cells were found.

## Evidence
- Before (main):
  - Detour: run 40401681056 (main bbbdac21): "did not get round the wall in 420 ticks ... nav done true ... ahead [1: Block{minecraft:water}[level=7] ...] [2: water level=5] [3: water level=4]". #286's CI hit the same flake today (run 40568538341).
  - Chaser: stress run 40469592779, 1 of 10: chaser under "effect.minecraft.slowness 1", speed 0.175.
- Test first: c63079f9 is red on main, because `ArenaReady.sealed` does not exist (a compile error). It is also red locally on the behaviour: with the `sealed` call removed, "sealed_arena_has_no_fluid_after_openground failed! fluid in the sealed pocket at 0/2/8 after 20 ticks (0 fluid cells removed); the seal found 0 fluid cells, the test placed 2".
- After, local: `BAT_GAMETEST_ONLY=test:sealed_arena,test:vanilla_path` gives "All 4 required tests passed".
  - Same day, same command on main: flake-stress run 40570846741 (ref main, 6 runners): "vanilla_path_wall_detour_beyond_the_short_search_still_arrives: failed 1, passed 5".
- After, this branch (ac55939e): flake-stress run 40572402176 (shard 1, 6 runners, focus vanilla_path): [Stress] "6 runners; 4 with any failure":
  - "vanilla_path_melee_chaser_runs_down_a_walking_target: failed 0, passed 6"
  - "vanilla_path_shooter_closes_to_range_on_a_shifting_target: failed 0, passed 6"
  - "vanilla_path_wall_detour_beyond_the_short_search_still_arrives: failed 0, passed 6"
  - The 4 runs with a failure are other tests in shard 1, outside this PR's files:
    - "capture_bounded_when_barrier_hangs: failed 3, passed 3" ("forced 0 chunks, expected 1"). It is in `FogSnapshotGameTests` (Joisco #272's lane) and is just as red on main: 2 of 6 in run 40570846741, 1 of 10 in 40474555717.
    - "a_move_into_unloaded_chunks_walks_toward_it_never_stands_busy: failed 1, passed 5". It is in `OrdersObeyGameTests`, with its unit at x 4480, far from these arenas: a separate flake, reported here, not fixed in this PR.
  Read it with: gh run view <id> --json jobs --jq '.jobs[]|select(.name=="summary")|.databaseId'
  then: gh api repos/IamTheLovish/Beyond-and-Tabs/check-runs/<jobid>/annotations --jq '.[].message'
- `tools/check_java.py` on both files: 0 structural errors. The server/client import guard passes. `tools/prepush.sh --quick` on Windows fails check_java (argfile), the animation lab data and the shard lists ('test:men'), which are exactly the breakages #286 fixes; it fails the same way on main.

## Numbers for lovish / questions
- None. The daylight Slowness is game behaviour and stays as it is; only these tests opt out of it.

Do not merge without lovish's OK

VERDICT: PASS
REVIEWER: opus subagent (Command Center, Oct 27 evening)
SHA: ac55939e
FINDINGS:
1. noSunlight (PathingBudgetGameTests.java:77, :143): daylight Slowness is intended design (Unit.java:466-479, only when TimeUtils.isDay; sandbox cheat slipslopslap exists, PlayerServerEvents.java:154). Opting tests out removes a time-of-day variable, hides no player bug, changes no assertion. Caveat: 1 slowed failure in 10 does not prove causation; Gate 3 stress must report failed 0.
2. Doc: ArenaReady.java:98 says a Skeleton without a helmet gets Slowness; SkeletonUnit.java:281-286 is the reverse (helmet = SLOWNESS_II, no helmet = FIRE). PR body's "same exposure" for the shooter is wrong the same way. Harmless; fix the comment.
3. sealed scope (ArenaReady.java:68-91): template-relative x/z -1..16, y 1..5 only; template is 16x12x16; outside ring restored with putIfAbsent + setBlock(...,3); a neighbour arena ~21 blocks away is not touched.
4. Restore is skipped if whenTicking throws at tick 150 (ArenaReady.java:134-136) or on a timeout (late start: 150+420 > 500 for the detour test). Same gap as main's fence/rtsPathfinding for the detour test; the cheat leak is harmless (owner unique per test and slot, PathingBudgetGameTests.java:48). Follow-up: a timeout guard that runs restore.
5. sealed_arena_has_no_fluid_after_openGround (283-312) fails on behaviour without sealed (water at 8,5,8 survives openGround, flows in within 20 ticks; removed < 2 also fails). Restore correct; timeout 100 > 20.
6. Fluid handling correct: waterlogged, flowing/source alike, all cells in one tick before scheduled fluid ticks; no back-flow path found.
7. Scope: ArenaReady.java:86 also stones non-full non-fluid rim cells in the chaser and shooter tests (beyond 3a's fluid scan). Removes a layout variable, not an assertion; say so in the PR body.
8. No leftover debug code.

[Stress] flake-stress run 40581759617 on claude/flake-015b-pathing-arenas (head ac55939e), tests sealed_arena_has_no_fluid_after_openGround + the three vanilla_path_* tests: 6 runners; 0 with any failure.

Correction: the earlier "[Stress] 0 with any failure" from run 40581759617 does not count. That run passed bare test names without the `test:` prefix, so BAT_GAMETEST_ONLY matched nothing and every sample logged "All 0 required tests passed". The same happened to the stress runs for #136 (40582259285) and #287 (40582056986).

Rerun with `test:` prefixes, 8 runners, on claude/flake-015b-pathing-arenas: https://github.com/IamTheLovish/Beyond-and-Tabs/actions/runs/40591024675. The [Stress] line comes after that run.

Correction to my [Stress] comment above: flake-stress 40581759617 was dispatched with bare test names (no `test:` prefix) and ran 0 tests ("All 0 required tests passed" on every runner), so it is not evidence. The real evidence is shard-1 run 40572402176: each vanilla_path_* test failed 0 of 6. The new sealed_arena_has_no_fluid_after_openGround has passed in CI but has not been stress-run; a run with -f tests=test:sealed_arena_has_no_fluid_after_openGround on main would close that.
